messages:
From: Erin Park <erin@novushealth.com>
To: maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-22T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: POC environment and MAP -- keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the hosted API flow. Our small integration team is ready to run a 30-day POC but we need the mutual action plan (MAP) spelled out so we can route approvals. Primary asks from our infra and procurement:

- Org setup (we need a seeded org in your console, permissions for two engineers)
- API key provisioning and recommended ephemeral rotation cadence
- IP allowlist entries for our staging CIDR (10.48.12.0/24) and guidance for scaled IP ranges
- VPC peering options and expected timeline (we'd prefer peering to avoid public endpoints)

Can you please send a short MAP with target dates for each of these items and a single point of contact on your side for technical handoff + procurement? We also attached a one-page vendor checklist for procurement — hoping to close internal paperwork next week.

Thanks,
Erin Park
CTO, Novus Health
Erin Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0128

Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC environment and MAP -- keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Hi Erin — great to hear and thanks for the checklist. I pulled together a compact MAP and a suggested two-week ramp to get you fully seeded for a 30-day evaluation. High level proposed cadence below (I attached our MAP template and a short peering diagram):

1) Day 0–1: Org seed + Console access
   - I will create a Novus evaluation org and invite two engineers (Jonas will provision roles).
   - Deliverable: seeded org, console invite, short onboarding note.

2) Day 1–2: API keys + rotation guidance
   - We will issue one scoped API key for staging and one long-lived service key for workload orchestration; recommend weekly ephemeral rotation for staging during the POC.
   - Deliverable: keys, sample rotation script, and token TTL notes.

3) Day 2–4: IP allowlist & network testing
   - Add your staging CIDR (10.48.12.0/24) to allowlist. If you need expanded ranges we can add /20 ranges on request with a change ticket.
   - Deliverable: confirmation of allowlist entries and curl-based smoke tests.

4) Day 3–7: VPC peering exchange + validation
   - We support cloud-provider VPC peering (recommended) or secure VPN as fallback. Jonas will own the peering steps; typical turnaround is 48–72 hours after we receive your VPC info and the peering form.
   - Deliverable: peering established, endpoint DNS, and internal IP route validation.

5) Day 7–14: Full runbook & performance baseline
   - Baseline test suite run, latency/cost snapshot shared, and a short joint call to validate SLOs.

Point people:
- Commercial/Coordination: me (maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com)
- Technical (peering + keys): jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
- Security/compliance questions: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

I attached our MAP template (redwood-map-template.xlsx) and the peering diagram (peering-eks-network-diagram.png). If that cadence looks OK to you we can lock dates and I will open the peering request form.

Best,
Maya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 (650) 555-4410

Attachments: redwood-map-template.xlsx, peering-eks-network-diagram.png
